title: Agent Board: canonical orchestration and the execution boundary — dependency binding
scope: Dependency gate for S2-007 (issue #7 §1). Everything S2-007 builds on is bound here to the bytes of a pinned canonicalization commit in origin/main, to the digest of the S2-007 frozen contract foundation, and to a declarative expectation of what the upstream surfaces must still say. Nothing here is inferred from a previous task's description, from a local PASS, from a dirty worktree or from a matching branch name.
rule: A missing, drifted or unverifiable mandatory upstream binding is BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY (gate exit 1). A warning is never a substitute: either the binding is proven from Git bytes, or no S2-007 implementation result may be recorded. Green sub-checks are never inferred from a sibling check, and a check is never renamed to obtain a green status.

parentRoles.first: S2-005 canonical merge; the exact same commit the S2-006 dependency record pins as its own canonicalization merge, so the upstream chain is proven continuous instead of assumed
parentRoles.second: S2-006 independent semantic verifier PR #19 branch head

base.implementationBaseRule: HEAD must descend from the canonicalization commit. An implementation on a branch that does not contain the pinned base is BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY, never a soft warning.
base.advancePolicy: A later advance of origin/main is refused until a reviewed rebind record exists in this file. An ancestor check alone is not a bind: it proves history, not that the protected S2-001/S2-002 surface is unchanged.
base.expectedParentsRule: Recorded shape, checked against reality by two independent git plumbing reads. The ORIGINAL canonicalization commit f590d37 was the two-parent reviewed merge of PR #19 and that shape proved continuity with the S2-006 record; after the reviewed rebase the pinned commit d23b289 is an ordinary single-parent commit, so the shape that is now pinned and checked is that commit's actual single parent. Continuity with f590d37 is no longer asserted by merge shape: it is asserted by the rebaseBinding block, which re-verifies 29 protected S2-001/S2-002 inputs byte for byte across the advance.

rebaseBinding.rule: origin/main advanced while S2-007 was in flight. A plain ancestor check is NOT a bind, so this block names the commit origin/main moved FROM and the commit it moved TO, and carries the SHA-256 of every protected S2-001/S2-002 canonical input as read from the PREVIOUS commit. scripts/verify-s2-007-dependencies.mjs re-reads each of those paths at the pinned commit and requires the bytes to be identical; a path that moved, a path missing from this block, and a divergence instead of a fast-forward advance all fail closed. This binding is a reviewed, measured rebase, not an assertion.
rebaseBinding.whatChangedUpstream: The advance is additive elsewhere: the SLOQUAL-001 contract pair, its scripts, src/lib/sloqual, Stage 1 closure docs and the shared evidence records. It touches no S2-001/S2-002 canonical input, none of the eight S2-007 board contracts, and no board code. The 29 bound paths below are byte-identical across the rebase.

upstreamCanonicalization.readRule: Every path below is read ONLY through `git show <canonicalizationCommit>:<path>`. Its Git blob id, its SHA-256 and its byte length must all match this record. The working tree is never the source of an upstream binding, and a self-generated narrative is never an independent expectation.

frozenManifest.role: An expectation authored by an earlier reviewed freeze, read from the canonicalization commit. Where it claims a path below, its SHA-256 must equal this record. Where it does not claim a path, the Git-bytes digest above stays binding and the gap is recorded instead of ignored.

s2_002ComparisonIntegrity.role: Independent digests for the three S2-002 replay payloads (run A, run B, comparison), so their digests are not only self-consistent with this record.

reRunGates.deferralRule: The root manifest is regenerated once, at the very end of S2-007, because the S2-007 file inventory is not final while the gate runs. A non-zero exit whose output carries one of `staleManifestSignatures` is recorded as REQUIRES_FINAL_MANIFEST with its REAL exit code. It is never reported as green and never reported as a dependency failure. Any other non-zero exit is a real FAILED_NONZERO and blocks.
staleManifestSignatures: root manifest file records differ from git inventory
root manifest payload manifest digest differs
root manifest file manifest digest differs

sandboxGate.rule: The internal S2-002 sandbox gate status must ALLOW exactly the profile S2-007 requests. `isExecutableSandboxProfile(requestedProfileId)` must be true AND the profile's `os_controls_evidence` digest must equal the SHA-256 of the Git bytes of the S2-002 sandbox evidence at the canonicalization commit. If the gate does not ALLOW this profile, the LIVE run stays forbidden, the record says so, and the gate is BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY. A NO_EXEC or *_blocked profile can never be a substitute.

upstreamVersionedArtifactReferences.rule: S2-003/004/005 may contribute EXPLICIT references to versioned artifacts only. A reference is a path plus a pinned SHA-256 plus, where the artifact carries one, a version anchor that must be a full commit object that exists and is an ancestor of the canonicalization commit. Their CONTENT never becomes a scheduler instruction: the gate asserts that no file under src/lib/agentboard/ names any of these artifact paths, so the board cannot read them at runtime.

s2_006e.rule: S2-006E is NOT a mandatory dependency of the S2-007 core. A verifier-derived signal may be used ONLY as an engineering property, and only when its canonicalization is verified separately. The official S2-006 status NEEDS_INPUT and the absent independent semantic calibration FORBID using such a signal as an automatic Gate for DONE.
admittedProperties: deterministic canonical JSON and digest convention (canonical-json-v1)
contract validation of a verifier payload, when the payload is contract-valid
the presence of an engineering-complete implementation with recorded engineering evidence
forbiddenUses: approval of a task by an uncalibrated semantic verifier
closure of an unknown external outcome
any raise of the S2-006 verdict above NEEDS_INPUT

doneReachabilityAssertion.rule: No code path in src/lib/agentboard/ may reach DONE from a verifier signal. The gate proves this structurally from the frozen transition table and textually from the source tree; a hit is never a warning.
structural: DONE has no outgoing edge in TRANSITIONS
DONE has exactly one incoming edge, IN_REVIEW -> DONE, guarded by guardInReviewToDone
guardInReviewToDone calls assertHumanOnlyApproval and assertNotSelfApproved and names no verifier signal
textual: no module under src/lib/agentboard/ imports a verifier decision module (../verifier/canonical-json.mjs is the only permitted reuse, and it is a digest convention)
no line under src/lib/agentboard/ names a verifier signal token and the DONE state without a refusal marker
the approval actor-kind set is a subset of human_owner, human_reviewer, deterministic_gate

s2_007FrozenFoundation.rule: The eight S2-007 contract schemas, the 0008 migration and the three frozen modules are recorded by SHA-256 and must be byte-identical both in the recorded commit and in the working tree. The frozen foundation is read, never weakened, extended or re-declared by this gate.

liveRunRestrictions: No real AgentOS/Codex/pi adapter is installed here, so any run without a genuinely different installed adapter is NOT_RUN_REAL_ADAPTER.
The S2-006 NEEDS_INPUT verdict and the absent independent semantic calibration forbid an automatic verifier Gate for DONE.
A live run requires the sandbox gate to ALLOW exactly sbx-podman-local-restricted-v1; NO_EXEC and the *_blocked profiles are not substitutes.
Fixture and replay evidence never upgrade a real-adapter run to PASS and never to A-MVP PASS.
consequence: While this gate is BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY, S2-007 may document and design offline but may not record an implementation result and may not run an executor. A green gate binds S2-007 to the pinned bytes above; it does not authorize live execution, does not upgrade NOT_RUN_REAL_ADAPTER and does not close issue #7.

deferred.reason: root manifest is regenerated once at the end of S2-007; the recorded exit code is the real one

src/lib/agentboard/contracts.mjs.reason: assertExecutionVersion anchored its semver check to a bare ^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$ but was handed the prefixed veritas.execution/1.1.0, so the same-major/different-minor negotiated-subset branch was unreachable and a well-formed minor bump was reported as "not a semantic version". RED test tests/agentboard/contracts.test.mjs ("the same major with another minor is only a negotiated subset") proved it. The fix reads the semver from after the last slash, which STRENGTHENS the handshake: an unknown major is still rejected before any read, and a non-semver version is still refused.

src/lib/agentboard/constants.mjs.reason: SANDBOX_HOST_UNISOLATED and its two predicates (isHostUnisolatedSandboxProfile, classifySandboxProfile) were added for issue #45. The proven set PROVEN_SANDBOX_PROFILE_IDS is UNCHANGED, so isExecutableSandboxProfile keeps meaning 'this tier has measured OS controls' and assertSandboxExecutable still refuses the floor tier on its own. Nothing is widened: the floor is admitted only through assertLiveExecutionAuthorized, which demands a named human authorisation the server resolves. RED test tests/agentboard/unisolated-authorization.test.mjs ('the floor tier is not an executable sandbox profile') proved the old constant set refused the new tier, and the 432-test board suite passes unchanged. Decision: docs/decisions/2026-09-26-s2-007r-host-unisolated-tier.md

src/lib/agentboard/policy.mjs.reason: Added assertUnisolatedExecutionAuthorized and assertLiveExecutionAuthorized, and routed the per-edge gate in assertAdapterCoversTask through the live gate. The defect was MEASURED, not argued: policy.assertSandboxExecutable answered BLOCKED_SANDBOX on sbx-host-unisolated-v1, so tasks.claim, tasks.lease.reassign and execution.start were all unreachable on the floor tier and no governed run could exist (results/s2-007r/cell-*/run-record.json, 'claim-refused'). The live gate is STRICTLY STRONGER than the check it replaces: an isolated profile needs nothing and REFUSES a permit, the floor needs a complete one, and every other profile is refused exactly as before. RED tests: tests/agentboard/unisolated-authorization.test.mjs (9 tests, including every single-field mutation of the permit and the window judged against the injected clock).

src/lib/agentboard/scheduler.mjs.reason: Two changes under the same measured defect. (1) toInjectedInstant moved to the new src/lib/agentboard/clock.mjs and re-exported here, because policy.mjs had to evaluate the authorisation window and scheduler.mjs already imports policy.mjs; the second copy of a clock parser the two modules shared is the drift this repository forbids. (2) The planning and admission path now consults assertLiveExecutionAuthorized with the same authorisation commands.mjs passes, so a tick and a manual execution.start can no longer disagree about whether a run is allowed. Behaviour for every already-proven profile is unchanged: sandboxProvenFor still returns false for a profile outside the proven set that carries no authorisation. RED test: the same suite, plus the 432-test board suite unchanged.

src/lib/agentboard/commands.mjs.reason: execute() and runSchedulerTick() accept a server-resolved `unisolatedExecutionAuthorization` option, guardContextFor forwards it, execution.start returns the sandboxDecision it admitted, and crossCheckAdapterAgainstTask uses the live gate. The authorisation is deliberately NOT a payload argument: an adapter, a task, an execution event, a skill or a replayed record can neither supply nor widen it, so the confused-deputy rule is unchanged. The defect was measured: commands.mjs:1793 answered BLOCKED_SANDBOX on the claim edge and no lease ever opened. RED tests: tests/agentboard/unisolated-authorization.test.mjs plus the full 432-test board suite.

src/lib/identity/sandbox-profiles.mjs.reason: SANDBOX_HOST_UNISOLATED added for issue #45 with os_controls_evidence bound to the digest of evidence/s2-007r-host-unisolated.json, a record of the MEASURED ABSENCE of OS controls: no node/codex/pi in the pinned isolation image, no route under --network=none, and mounts:0 + injectedEnvironment:0 + secret_handles:[] meaning no credential could reach a containerised child. The profile declares network.policy 'unrestricted' and environment.allowlist ['*'] because those are the controls it does not have, and the schema forbids this tier from claiming deny_all, an allowlist or a secret handle. The four existing profiles are untouched. Script: scripts/verify-s2-007r-host-unisolated.mjs (exit 0).

contracts/sandbox-profile.schema.json.reason: The `HOST_UNISOLATED` tier and the `unrestricted` network policy were added, with the constraint that makes the tier unable to impersonate an isolated one: HOST_UNISOLATED MUST declare unrestricted network and the '*' environment and MUST NOT carry a secret handle, and the mirror rule forbids an isolated tier from declaring unrestricted or a wildcard environment. Additive: no existing document changes validity, because no existing profile uses the new values. RED tests: tests/identity/contracts.schemas.test.mjs, four new cases pinning both directions (40/40 pass).
